import json
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "/root/trace-verdict-study")
from vota import FullTraceFormatter

MAX_SEQ_LENGTH = 2048
CHAT_TEMPLATE_OVERHEAD = 32
MAX_TRACE_TOKENS = 384


def load_raw_data(path):
    data = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if line:
                data.append(json.loads(line))
    return data


def load_test_code_mapping():
    from datasets import load_dataset
    os.environ["HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE"] = "1"
    mapping = {}
    he = load_dataset("openai_humaneval", split="test",
                      cache_dir="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache")
    for item in he:
        mapping[item["task_id"]] = item["test"]
    mbpp_ds = load_dataset("mbpp", "sanitized",
                           cache_dir="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache")
    seen = set()
    for split in mbpp_ds:
        for item in mbpp_ds[split]:
            tid = item["task_id"]
            if tid in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(tid)
            mapping[f"MBPP/{tid}"] = "\n".join(item["test_list"])
    return mapping


def split_by_problem_id(data, train_ratio=0.8, seed=42):
    import random
    from collections import defaultdict
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    by_problem = defaultdict(list)
    for item in data:
        by_problem[item["problem_id"]].append(item)
    problem_ids = sorted(by_problem.keys())
    rng.shuffle(problem_ids)
    n_train = int(len(problem_ids) * train_ratio)
    train_ids = set(problem_ids[:n_train])
    train_data, test_data = [], []
    for pid in problem_ids:
        target = train_data if pid in train_ids else test_data
        target.extend(by_problem[pid])
    return train_data, test_data


def _get_test_code(item, test_code_map):
    tc = item.get("test_code")
    if tc:
        return tc
    return test_code_map.get(item["problem_id"], "")


def _build_input(code, test_code, trace_text=None):
    parts = [
        f"Given the following code:\n{code}\n\n",
        f"Test code:\n{test_code}\n\n",
    ]
    if trace_text is not None:
        parts.append(f"Execution trace:\n{trace_text}\n\n")
    parts.append("Does this code pass all tests? Answer: ")
    return "".join(parts)


def truncate_trace_tail_384(code, test_code, trace_text, label, tokenizer, max_seq_length):
    """Truncate trace keeping the TAIL, capped at MAX_TRACE_TOKENS tokens."""
    trace_tokens = tokenizer.encode(trace_text, add_special_tokens=False)

    marker = "[...trace truncated...]\n"
    marker_token_count = len(tokenizer.encode(marker, add_special_tokens=False))

    if len(trace_tokens) > MAX_TRACE_TOKENS:
        truncated_trace = marker + tokenizer.decode(trace_tokens[-MAX_TRACE_TOKENS:], skip_special_tokens=True)
        was_truncated = True
    else:
        truncated_trace = trace_text
        was_truncated = False

    input_text = _build_input(code, test_code, truncated_trace)

    full_tokens = tokenizer.encode(input_text + label, add_special_tokens=False)
    if len(full_tokens) > max_seq_length - CHAT_TEMPLATE_OVERHEAD:
        no_trace_input = _build_input(code, test_code, "")
        no_trace_tokens = len(tokenizer.encode(no_trace_input + label, add_special_tokens=False))
        trace_budget = max_seq_length - CHAT_TEMPLATE_OVERHEAD - no_trace_tokens - marker_token_count
        trace_budget = min(trace_budget, MAX_TRACE_TOKENS)
        if trace_budget <= 0:
            input_text = _build_input(code, test_code, "[...trace truncated...]")
        else:
            truncated_trace = marker + tokenizer.decode(trace_tokens[-trace_budget:], skip_special_tokens=True)
            input_text = _build_input(code, test_code, truncated_trace)
        was_truncated = True

    return input_text, was_truncated

    from transformers import AutoTokenizer

    model_path = "/root/trace-verdict-study/models/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct"
    raw_path = "/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-data/raw_traces.jsonl"
    output_dir = "/root/autodl-tmp/trace-verdict-study-data/"

    print("Loading tokenizer...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path)

    print("Loading test code mapping...")
    test_code_map = load_test_code_mapping()
    print(f"Loaded test code for {len(test_code_map)} problems")

    print(f"Loading raw data from {raw_path}")
    data = load_raw_data(raw_path)
    print(f"Total samples: {len(data)}")

    train_data, test_data = split_by_problem_id(data, 0.8, 42)
